method: Same actor-free entrance view and diagnostic white viewmodel geometry mask, not a photometric visibility or aiming/FPS/comfort measurement. Transparent surfaces count as opaque geometry. Two loaded phone orientations and two weapons; exact zoom-mask counts and control rectangles checked. Baseline frozen Build123 on61519; candidate production. The diagnostic excludes world/HUD occlusion and counts projected viewmodel geometry rather than photometric screen coverage.
limits: More clearance does not establish improved target acquisition or enjoyment.
Original aimed pose is preserved; hip geometry and its scene-tap mask move down.
Fallback/safe-area cases checked separately; paired percentages describe loaded models only.
